title: Generating Mitigations for Downstream Projects to Neutralize Upstream Library Vulnerability
abstract: arXiv:2503.24273v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Third-party libraries are essential in software development as they prevent the need for developers to recreate existing functionalities. However, vulnerabilities within these libraries pose significant risks to dependent projects. Upgrading dependencies is infeasible when no patched version is available or when downstream projects have strict version constraints. Moreover, repairing the vulnerability proves challenging when the source code of the library is inaccessible. State-of-the-art automatic vulnerability repair and automatic program repair methods both fail to address this issue. Therefore, mitigating library vulnerabilities without access to source code or available patches is crucial for a swift response to potential security attacks. translated_title: 为下游项目生成缓解措施以消除上游库漏洞
translated_abstract: 第三方库在软件开发中至关重要，因为它们使开发者无需重新实现已有的功能。然而，这些库中的漏洞会对依赖它们的项目构成重大风险。当没有补丁版本可用，或下游项目存在严格的版本约束时，升级依赖项是不可行的。此外，当无法访问库的源代码时，修复漏洞也极具挑战性。最先进的自动漏洞修复和自动程序修复方法都无法解决这一问题。因此，在无法访问源代码或没有可用补丁的情况下缓解库漏洞，对于快速响应潜在的安全攻击至关重要。现有工具在通用性和功能安全方面存在挑战。在漏洞披露后，LUMEN 通过检索准备一个候选缓解策略池……
tldr: 提出LUMEN方法，在无法获取上游库源代码或补丁的情况下，为下游项目自动生成缓解措施，以中和上游第三方库的漏洞。
en_tdlr: Proposes LUMEN, which automatically generates mitigations for downstream projects to neutralize upstream library vulnerabilities without requiring access to the library's source code or available patches.
